_comment: Copy to gate1.config.json (next to /hooks) to override the built-in defaults. Precedence: explicit env override > this file > built-in default. Credentials are NEVER stored here — they are read from env (SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL for consults; SAGE_GATE1_ACCRED_CREDENTIAL + SAGE_GATE1_AGENT_ID for H4's accreditation write — a NON-marker credential, never the standing pre_decision_harness marker). H4 refuses to write on the marker: name it via SAGE_GATE1_MARKER_CREDENTIAL (defaults to the consult credential, covering the dogfood) so the guard refuses it by identity — name it explicitly at Slice 5b when consult ≠ marker. H4's reflect/accred endpoints derive from `endpoint` (…/api/reason → …/api/practice/reflect, …/api/accreditation) unless GATE1_REFLECT_ENDPOINT / GATE1_ACCRED_ENDPOINT are set. H3/H4 are BUILT DARK in Slice 5a — these fields take effect only once the hooks are installed at the founder-walked Slice 5b.
_h3_comment: H3 at-action hook (the guard/score/iterate cadence). captureProvenance accumulates each consult's signed assessment for H4's accreditation write (D-D) — DEFAULT OFF so H1/H2 stay byte-identical; set GATE1_PROVENANCE_ENABLED=true (with H3/H4) at activation. guardFailMode governs ONLY the guardrail OUTAGE (a genuine do_not_proceed always blocks). irreversiblePatterns/guardTools define the guard subset (D-A).
